results.description:
She told a drug lord's men to get off her property. Then the president of the Black Hills Renegades walked out of her bar and put one of them through a truck window.

Maren Caldwell has been running the Broken Spur alone for twenty years. She doesn't need a motorcycle club claiming her roadhouse — or a granite-jawed biker who looks at her like she already belongs to him.

Kodiak doesn't ask permission. And he doesn't let anyone touch what's his.

When a cartel-backed drug lord targets Maren's bar as the cornerstone of a new distribution network, Kodiak puts her under club protection — whether she likes it or not. But Maren isn't the kind of woman who follows orders. She's the kind who grabs a shotgun and holds the door herself.

Now he's fighting a war on two fronts: a drug operation with enough muscle to burn the Hills to the ground, and a woman who's making him feel things he buried the day he came home to bury his brother.

As the body count rises and the threats turn personal, they'll have to decide what they're willing to fight for — and what they're willing to lose.

Kodiak is a full-length, standalone MC romance with a possessive alpha hero, a heroine with backbone for days, explosive action, and steamy scenes. No cliffhanger. HEA guaranteed.
